runtimeChanges: Type-only imports route to structurally copied native types.
Pure color helpers share the existing canonical library palette.
VoiceHover helper extracted without instrument-grouping application policy.
VoiceZIndicesContext extracted without host sorting policy.
Optional getNoteAttributes.className is appended only when supplied; original default markup remains exact.
noteModel: Seconds-based original Note and ColoredNote, with separate source spans/pitches and optional display spans/pitches.
contexts: All native consumers must import the same compiled librawl/native module; never instantiate duplicate context copies.

remainingHostResponsibilities: CSS palette/voice-shape styles must be loaded by the host.
Audio backend and source parsing stay in the host.
Seconds-to-pixels and pitch-to-pixels remain explicit callback inputs.
verification.colorStyles: nativeColorStyles output equals original Rawl createGlobalStyle template exactly

noteTooltips.policy: Individual native note title attributes are suppressed, including host-supplied titles; accessibility labels, source attributes and note interactions are retained.
noteTooltips.fixturePolicy: Original upstream renderer fixture bytes stay unchanged. Source parity ignores only the added title suppression line.
